title: 3.1.12 Project — Spinning Sculpture
description: Build a complete Spinning Sculpture: two stacked Cubes rotating on multiple axes with frameCount, color cycling, and one creative element of your own.

steps.title: Rotate bigCube on Y
steps.instructions: In draw(), set `bigCube.rotation.y = radians(frameCount * 1.5)` to spin the base cube on the Y axis.
hints: radians(frameCount * 1.5) grows each frame, spinning the cube. Adjust the multiplier to taste.

steps.title: Also rotate bigCube on X
steps.instructions: Add `bigCube.rotation.x = radians(frameCount * 0.7)` with a different (slower) multiplier than Y.
hints: Using a different speed on X vs Y creates an interesting compound tumble.

steps.title: Stack smallCube on top
steps.instructions: Call `parent(smallCube, bigCube)` after both cubes are created. Set `smallCube.position.y = 1.3` to place it above bigCube.
hints: parent() makes smallCube's position relative to bigCube's coordinate space.

steps.title: Spin smallCube opposite-direction on Z
steps.instructions: In draw(), set `smallCube.rotation.z = radians(-frameCount * 2)` to spin it the other way on Z.
hints: The minus sign reverses the direction. Try different multipliers.

steps.title: Cycle colors
steps.instructions: In draw(), compute a sine-driven color channel and set `bigCube.color` to a dynamic rgb() or hex string so the colors shift over time.
hints: Math.sin(radians(frameCount * speed)) oscillates between -1 and +1. Map it to a 0–255 range with Math.floor(128 + 127 * Math.sin(...)).

steps.title: Add one creative element
steps.instructions: Add ONE new element of your own design and document it with a `// MY ELEMENT:` comment. Examples: a third Cube parented to smallCube, a pulsing scale using Math.sin on cube.size, or keyboard control that freezes rotation.
hints: Any creative addition counts — the comment is required so the grader can find it.

requirements.title: At least 2 rotation axes on bigCube
requirements.description: bigCube.rotation.y AND at least one of rotation.x or rotation.z are assigned.

requirements.title: radians() used at least twice
requirements.description: The radians() helper appears in the rotation math.

requirements.title: parent() called
requirements.description: parent() is used to stack the second cube.

requirements.title: Color cycling present
requirements.description: A shape's color is driven by Math.sin, Math.cos, Math.floor, Math.abs, or frameCount.

requirements.title: Creative element documented
requirements.description: A // MY ELEMENT: comment is present.
